note: Payload sizes fixed by third-party specifications, used so the residual is not compared only against a quantity this study defined. Not a claim about what the July 2026 incident actually transmitted.

payloads.name: AWS access key ID
payloads.derivation: 20 characters, of which a fixed 4-character prefix ('AKIA') is not information; the remaining 16 are base32.

payloads.name: UUID version 4
payloads.derivation: 128 bits less 4 version bits and 2 variant bits, which are fixed by the standard.

payloads.name: GitHub personal access token
payloads.derivation: 36 base62 characters following a fixed 'ghp_' prefix that carries no information.
